name: purva-ocean-monorepo
description: Purva Ocean Adventures - Fullstack Architecture (Frontend + Backend)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "frontend,backend" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
